title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
script:
OpenAI just released a manuscript claiming to refute the Exponential Time Hypothesis.
This hypothesis long suggested that certain complex problems require exponential time to compute.
MIT professor Ryan Williams is now leading the academic verification of these claims.
If confirmed, this would upend our understanding of computational complexity limits.
The manuscript suggests that machines might solve these problems much faster than previously thought.
Experts caution that these proofs are still undergoing rigorous peer review.
Are you ready for computers to solve the unsolvable?
